title: Bali and Phuket Island Escape
alt: The cliffs above Kelingking beach on Nusa Penida in Bali
transport: Private transfers with speedboat island crossings

expert.name: Ananya Iyer
expert.quote: Two very different islands in one week. Bali for the cliffs, Phuket for the boat days and the old town.
expert.tip: The Nusa Penida crossing can be choppy, so take something for motion sickness and sit at the back. Book the Bali to Phuket flight for late morning so you keep the Kuta breakfast.

summary: Six days across Bali and Phuket. Two nights in Kuta with a speedboat day to Nusa Penida and its four beaches, then three nights in Patong with the Phi Phi islands by boat and a Phuket city tour.
included: Included: 5 nights in Kuta and Phuket with daily breakfast; Nusa Penida west coast tour with four beaches; Phi Phi islands speedboat tour with lunch; Phuket city tour; 13 airport, harbour and sightseeing transfers.
not_included: Not included: international flights; the Bali to Phuket flight; visa charges; travel insurance; island and temple entry fees; lunches and dinners other than the Phi Phi tour lunch; personal expenses.

1: Arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport and private transfer to your Kuta hotel
Check in at Kuta Central Park and keep the first day free
Optional: grilled seafood at Jimbaran, the Kuta night market or Petitenget temple
2: Breakfast, then private transfer across to Sanur harbour
Speedboat transfer over to Nusa Penida for the west coast tour
Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach
Return speedboat and private transfer to your Kuta hotel
3: Breakfast, check out and private transfer to Ngurah Rai Airport
Optional: flight from Bali to Phuket, booked separately and not included
Private sedan transfer from Phuket airport to your Patong resort
Optional: the Big Buddha, Banana beach or Tiger Kingdom close by
4: Breakfast, then shared transfer down to the Phuket pier
Speedboat transfer out to the Phi Phi group for the whole day
Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, with lunch
Return speedboat and shared transfer to your resort
5: Breakfast, then shared transfer for the Phuket city tour
Wat Chalong, Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint on the west coast
Afternoon free beside the pool or down on the beach
6: Breakfast and an easy check out
Private sedan transfer to the airport for your trip home

stops.name: Kuta
stops.accom: 2 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 4★ · Kuta Central Park, a short walk from Kuta beach

program.name: Kuta base with a Nusa Penida day
program.description: Two nights in Kuta with one big day on the water, crossing to Nusa Penida for Kelingking beach and the west coast lookouts.

activities.name: Nusa Penida West Coast Tour
activities.description: A speedboat day to Nusa Penida taking in Kelingking beach, Angel's Billabong, Broken Bay and Bubu beach.

activities.name: Kuta Night Market
activities.description: Stalls of satay, grilled fish and sweets a few streets back from Kuta beach, busiest after eight.

activities.name: Pura Petitenget Temple
activities.description: A sea temple on the Seminyak sand, best at sunset when the offerings are laid out along the wall.

stops.name: Phuket
stops.accom: 3 nights · Breakfast included · Deluxe room · 3★ · Tony Resort in Patong, close to the beach road

program.name: Patong, Phi Phi and the old town
program.description: Three nights in Patong with a full day at the Phi Phi islands and a half day tour of Wat Chalong, the old town and Karon viewpoint.

activities.name: Phi Phi Islands by Speedboat
activities.description: A full day across the Phi Phi group with Maya Bay, Viking Cave, Loh Samah Bay and Monkey Beach, and lunch on the tour.

activities.name: Phuket City Tour
activities.description: A half day run through Wat Chalong, the painted shophouse streets of Old Phuket Town and Karon viewpoint.

activities.name: Phuket Big Buddha
activities.description: A white marble Buddha on Nakkerd hill with views over Chalong bay and Kata on a clear afternoon.

activities.name: Banana Beach
activities.description: A small bay on the north west coast with calm water and shade, reached down a steep track off the main road.
